## Brass Dragon, Young Adult (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
CG Large dragon (fire)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** blindsense 60 ft., dragon senses; Perception +21  


**Defense**


**AC** 25, touch 10, flat-footed 24 (+1 Dex, +15 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 126 (12d12+48)  
**Fort** +12, **Ref** +9, **Will** +10  
**DR** 5/magic; **Immune** fire, paralysis, *sleep*; **SR** 21  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** bite +18 (2d6+9), 2 claws +17 (1d8+6), 2 wings +12 (1d6+3), tail slap +12 (1d8+9)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (80-ft. line, DC 20, 10d4 fire), desert wind, sleep breath  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th; concentration +14)  

At will—*[endure elements](../../magic/spells/endure-elements.md)*, *[speak with animals](../../magic/spells/speak-with-animals.md)*  

**Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 5th; concentration +7)  

2nd (5/day)—*[alter self](../../magic/spells/alter-self.md)*, *[see invisibility](../../magic/spells/see-invisibility.md)*  
1st (7/day)—*[charm person](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)* (DC 14), *[protection from evil](../../magic/spells/protection-from-evil.md)*, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*, *[ventriloquism](../../magic/spells/ventriloquism.md)*  
0 (at will)—*[arcane mark](../../magic/spells/arcane-mark.md)*, *[dancing lights](../../magic/spells/dancing-lights.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)* (DC 12), *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*  


**Statistics**


**Str** 23, **Dex** 12, **Con** 19, **Int** 14, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 30 (34 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Alertness, Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Initiative, Spell Focus (Enchantment), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Bluff +17, Diplomacy +17, Fly +10, Heal +17, Linguistics +17, Perception +21, Sense Motive +21, Spellcraft +17  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, plus any 13 others  
**SQ** move sand  


**Special Abilities**


**Desert Wind (Su)** A juvenile or older brass dragon can call up the desert wind to serve him. This functions as *gust of wind*, but any creature in its path must make a Fortitude save (DC 20) or be blinded for 1d4 rounds by the sand.  

**Move Sand (Su)** A young or older brass dragon can move sand to excavate ruins or hide treasures. This functions as *move earth*, but it only affects sand. The dragon uses his HD in place of his caster level for this effect. This is equivalent to a 5th-level spell.  

**Sleep Breath (Su)** Instead of a line of fire, a brass dragon can breathe a 40 ft. cone of sleep gas. Creatures within the cone must succeed on a Will save or fall asleep for 1d6+5 rounds.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** warm deserts  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** triple
